description: Use this to show results in chat: generation_result_id (from mcp_brief_runs) for one result, generation_id for a job's results, or query, filters and dates to find past ones. Returns image previews to show as they are (never Markdown-embed result URLs); url is the original. Changes nothing.

inputSchema.description: Input schema for listing generation results.

art_direction_ids.description: Filter results to images generated with these art directions

avatar_ids.description: Filter results to images generated with these avatars

clothing_item_ids.description: Filter results to images generated with these clothing items

decision.description: Filter by the unified result verdict.

end_date.description: Filter results created on or before this ISO date/datetime, e.g. 2026-04-27.

generation_id.description: Filter by parent generation ID (lists all result images from one generation job)

generation_result_id.description: Look up a single result image by its generation_result_id (the exact integer ID required by QA/edit/upscale/video tools). Returns that one result directly.

include_snapshot.description: Include full generation settings, resource snapshots and raw prompt payloads. Large; use only for prompt recovery.

location_ids.description: Filter results to images generated with these locations

model_ids.description: Filter results to images generated with these AI models

outfit_ids.description: Filter results to images generated with these outfits

qa_statuses.description: Filter by QA statuses, e.g. pending, processing, completed, error.

query.description: Hybrid search across generated image content, originating item names, and SKUs.

start_date.description: Filter results created on or after this ISO date/datetime, e.g. 2026-04-20.

tag_ids.description: Filter by tag IDs (results must have at least one)

name: get_generation_results
title: Show Results
